test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

No bike is a car.

All cars are planes.

Conclusions

(I) No plane is a bike.

(II) All planes are cars.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8ea2afdc58b6c207a1b1d5b4b9f993cc16ad26ba6d6f6e630f7a57fa32652f2.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No plane is a bike → Does not follow (As no bike is a car and all cars are planes. As no direct relation is given between plane and bike, therefore it is false.)

(II) All planes are cars → Does not follow (As all cars are planes. So it is possible but not definite

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
